walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the OCR GCSE Food Technology specification.

Cooking and Food Preparation appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Cooking and Food Preparation in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The OCR board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Cooking and Food Preparation.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
